about: The Workbench icons of the Simutrans drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Simutrans' own program icon (src/android/icon.png, brought to 128x128 with rounded corners: art/simutrans.png). Simutrans-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Simutrans.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Simutrans.info. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (config, font, text, themes, script, ai, pak and theirs, save, screenshot, maps): the Makefile copies it to each name. ReadMe.info serves ReadMe, LICENSE.txt and readme.txt.
